docs.title: Module 3: The AI-Robot Brain (NVIDIA Isaac)
docs.description: Welcome to Module 3 of the AI Robotics Engineering curriculum! This module focuses on the NVIDIA Isaac ecosystem, which provides a comprehensive platform for developing AI-driven robotic systems. You'll learn how to leverage Isaac Sim for synthetic data generation, Isaac ROS for accelerated perception and navigation, and Nav2 for humanoid-specific path planning.

docs.title: Complete Integration Guide
docs.description: This comprehensive guide brings together all three chapters of the AI-Robot Brain module, showing how Isaac Sim, Isaac ROS, and Nav2 work together to create a complete AI-driven navigation system for humanoid robots.

docs.title: Isaac ROS Configuration Examples and Best Practices

docs.title: Isaac ROS Perception Overview
docs.description: Isaac ROS is a collection of hardware-accelerated perception and navigation packages designed specifically for robotics applications. Built on top of ROS2, Isaac ROS leverages NVIDIA's GPU computing capabilities to provide high-performance perception algorithms essential for humanoid robotics.

docs.title: Isaac ROS Troubleshooting Guide
docs.description: This guide provides solutions to common issues encountered when working with Isaac ROS for humanoid robotics applications. Use this guide to diagnose and resolve problems with perception, navigation, and system integration.

docs.title: Isaac ROS Perception Pipeline Tutorial
docs.description: This tutorial will guide you through implementing a complete perception pipeline using Isaac ROS for humanoid robots. You'll learn how to set up stereo vision, object detection, and integrate multiple perception components.

docs.title: Isaac ROS VSLAM Implementation Tutorial
docs.description: This tutorial will guide you through implementing and configuring Visual SLAM using Isaac ROS specifically for humanoid robot navigation. You'll learn how to set up visual-inertial SLAM, optimize parameters for humanoid applications, and integrate with navigation systems.

docs.title: Isaac ROS VSLAM and Navigation
docs.description: Visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VSLAM) is a critical capability for autonomous humanoid robots. Isaac ROS provides hardware-accelerated VSLAM implementations that enable real-time localization and mapping using visual sensors, essential for humanoid navigation in dynamic environments.

docs.title: Humanoid Robot Kinematic and Balance Constraints
docs.description: Humanoid robots have unique kinematic and balance constraints that significantly impact navigation planning and execution. Unlike wheeled robots, humanoid robots must maintain dynamic balance while navigating, which introduces complex constraints that must be considered in Nav2 configuration and path planning.

docs.title: Nav2 Path Planning for Humanoid Robots
docs.description: Navigation 2 (Nav2) is the next-generation navigation framework for ROS2, providing advanced path planning and navigation capabilities. When configured for humanoid robots, Nav2 must account for unique kinematic constraints, balance requirements, and social navigation considerations that differ significantly from wheeled robots.

docs.description: Welcome to Module 4 of the AI Robotics Engineering curriculum! This module focuses on connecting language, vision, and action for autonomous humanoid behavior. You'll learn how to build systems that understand natural language commands, perceive the environment through vision systems, and execute appropriate actions using robotic platforms.

docs.description: This section covers how to extract robot-appropriate intents from natural language commands. We'll explore techniques for understanding what the user wants the robot to do based on spoken or written input.
